authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11813 *vibhāna explicitly gives Kumaoni byān, Nepali biyāna, eastern bihān and WPah. bhèṇi dawn. It also allows an alternative MIA vibhāyana derivation. Short ben/bhen and byan forms fit the documented contracted dawn family; contraction and local transmission remain qualified, and the deeper alternative is not resolved. Exact response: bʸana.
